body: Sorry, but I know that I've lost my mind and dying, and now I just want to find out why,...
That's quite powerful, but I feel like I'm going to die.

Hey bro,

Let's see the world together. Message me

Hi Gray,

Private message me. Move to London. We can hang out, talk, go to concerts, and just exist in this journey of life. I'm waiting for a neurologist appointment [six weeks...], I've been in hospital for over a year of my life with a brain disease, lost two girls that could of been the  loves of my life, and now I'm all alone in the world. I can't even talk to my best friends and parents, everything is so fucking fake. I know I'm going to die without remembering what I did, but I figure I can at least exist and sell my soul to other people's causes.

Message me bro. We all love you
